1. Why 5s CCD Filtering & 4h Off-Line QC Fail Silicon Pullers
• 1,425°C CZ Meniscus 0.38Hz Wave & Dislocation Pop-Out:
Turbulent Marangoni/buoyancy convection in 450kg molten silicon
drives ±1.42mm meniscus oscillation, violating the Voronkov V/G
window and nucleating slip dislocations—forcing a 48h remelt of
a 300mm ingot and risking a $65,000 quartz crucible rupture.
• Siemens CVD 1,138°C Popcorn Silicon & Core-Melting Collapse:
Overheated silicon slim-rods (>1,135°C) nucleate porous popcorn
dust (ruining 11N electronic purity) and risk 1,414°C core-melting
rod collapse onto water-cooled reactor baseplates.
❌ Legacy 4-Cloud Stitched TCO: $162,800 / mo (Normalized)

2. Microsoft Fabric 78ms MCZ Ingot & Siemens CVD Loop
Step 1 · Eventhouse KQL (18ms · $0/GB Stream Write Tax)
Ingests 990K EPS (200Hz meniscus CCD + CVD pyrometers + 50kHz saws).
series_fft() isolates 0.38Hz meniscus wave (±1.42mm) & 1,138°C CVD rod
Step 2 · Fabric IQ + Cosmos SSD DiskANN (20ms · 212M Vectors)
Searches 212,000,000 Voronkov V/G defect boundaries, 3D Cusp-MCZ
Lorentz melt-convection tensors & SiHCl3 CVD vectors (0.99 sim, -92% RAM).
Step 3 · Foundry IQ Guardrail SOP-093 (20ms Hard Physics Gate)
Boosts Cusp-MCZ to 2,850G & trims pull speed -4.2% (ring→±0.12mm, 100% ZD,
Oi 11.2ppma) & trims CVD current -3.1% (rod→1,092°C, 11N purity).
Step 4 · ALDO Puller-Hall Edge + SDS Silicon Commit (20ms)
Dispatches EtherCAT magnet/servo/CVD setpoints at hall edge & mints
11N CoA & 11.4 kgCO2e/kg Si Low-Carbon Silicon passport into 1GB SQL.
